question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
-- Check total row count
WITH last_races AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT cs.race_id, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lr.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC, cs.constructor_id ASC) as rn
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
),
top_drivers AS (
    SELECT ds.race_id, ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lr.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC, ds.driver_id ASC) as rn
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
)
SELECT lr.year, 
       td.forename || ' ' || td.surname as driver_name,
       tc.constructor_name
FROM last_races lr
JOIN top_constructors tc ON lr.last_race_id = tc.race_id AND tc.rn = 1
JOIN top_drivers td ON lr.last_race_id = td.race_id AND td.rn = 1
ORDER BY lr.year

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Get the last race_id per year
WITH last_races AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
-- Get the top constructor per year (most points at the last race)
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT cs.race_id, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lr.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC, cs.constructor_id ASC) as rn
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
),
-- Get the top driver per year (most points at the last race)
top_drivers AS (
    SELECT ds.race_id, ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lr.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC, ds.driver_id ASC) as rn
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
)
SELECT lr.year, 
       td.forename || ' ' || td.surname as driver_name,
       tc.constructor_name
FROM last_races lr
JOIN top_constructors tc ON lr.last_race_id = tc.race_id AND tc.rn = 1
JOIN top_drivers td ON lr.last_race_id = td.race_id AND td.rn = 1
ORDER BY lr.year
LIMIT 20"}
